name: Steak Kabobs with Mediterranean Spice Rub & Cauliflower Tabouli Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: If using wooden skewers, place 12 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
3 lemons
1 ½ small bunches green onions (scallions)
1 ½ English cucumbers
6 tomatoes
1 ½ small bunches Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ small pkgs fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: Cut the cauliflower heads into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower.
Preheat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cauliflower, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until crisp-tender, 6-7 minutes. Transfer cauliflower to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer to cool.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, combine spices in a large bowl; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ¼ tsp salt
1 tbsp cumin
2 tsp paprika
¾ tsp coriander
¾ tsp black pepper
3 pinch cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut the steak into 1½-inch cubes; transfer to the bowl with the spices and toss to coat; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.primary_message: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
Thread steak onto the skewers and place on a plate. Alternatively, you can cook the steak pieces directly on the grill/skillet without using skewers.

Coat the grill or skillet with oil. Cooking in batches if necessary, place kabobs on the grill, rotating every 2½ minutes, until browned and cooked through, about 10 minutes. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Meanwhile, grate the zest from the lemons and transfer to a large bowl, then juice the lemons into the same bowl. Add the cauliflower and stir to combine.
Peel and mince garlic. Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Transfer both to the bowl with the cauliflower.
Peel and small dice the cucumbers. Small dice the tomatoes; add both to the bowl with the cauliflower.

Shave parsley leaves off the stems; pick mint leaves off the stems. Discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add herbs, oil, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the cauliflower and stir to combine the tabouli salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide tabouli between plates or bowls. Place steak kabobs on top and enjoy!
